cipher.summary: Added self-contained RateLimitSeam (Zod-schema contract, scenario-aware mock, throttled idle-key sweep, clock-rollback-safe `resetAtMs`) wired into all 6 metered AI-provider routes, plus SVG/WebP image-format detection and a saved-draft mimeType fallback, closing the in-scope unaddressed review threads from PR #171 and PR #180; `npm run verify` passed clean (svelte-check 0 errors/0 warnings, 553 tests passed/1 skipped, lint/build green).
cipher.risks: Rate limiting remains per-process in-memory state, so it will not coordinate across multiple server instances/regions. `enforceRateLimit` runs before request-body validation on all 6 routes by design, so a client's own malformed request still burns one slot of its own budget even though no provider call was made; this is judged a minor, self-inflicted cost against a single client's own quota rather than a cross-client abuse vector. CodeRabbit's `.jsonc`-for-evidence-files nitpicks on both source PRs are intentionally left unaddressed as low-value churn on auto-generated, dated evidence snapshots that aren't part of this feature.
